title: Is Your LiDAR Placement Optimized for 3D Scene Understanding?

layout.note: A top band holds two tinted dashed regions side by side, a wide blue one with the metric stages (a) to (c) and a narrow red one with the optimiser (d); a full-width grey band below holds a left-to-right icon chain ending in (f); curved arrows cross from the car and from (d) into the bottom band.

lesson: Give each phase of a multi-phase method its own tinted dashed region and keep that hue on heading, captions and arrows; let a curved arrow carry the result across regions, and zoom a heat-map point into the search loop that produces it.
